subtitle: A paper teacher, offline
promotional_text: A paper teacher on your phone: four walk steps, a rising-column breath, and a private journal.
description: Saltpaper is a complete offline teacher. Finish onboarding, follow Walk through four guidance steps, run Four Columns as a rising-column breath, choose a Range, and stamp a Tablet note. There is no account, no login, no cloud sync, and no remote AI. Your ticket length and journal stay on the device.
app_review_notes: Saltpaper is a fully offline attention-practice and private-journal app. Review flow: complete onboarding, open Walk and advance the four guidance steps, start Four Columns breathing, choose a Range, then save a Tablet note. No sign-in, network calls, camera, or photo library access.
